scope: Source and IR variants tried by lane amm-mid against frontier a4b978ee (native macOS v1.44 builds for iteration; llc experiments use the crate's own optimized IR). Counts are native-build normalized/raw windows (native base = 594/118; it differs from Linux 599/125 only in TypeId-bearing type_id bodies outside 0x3d828..0x724a0).

controls.variant: sell_a: move user/user_base_token_account/user_quote_token_account fields after the holder/mayhem conditionals in the struct literal
controls.result: 594/118, no gain; 0x52c58 regresses from 1 moved instruction to a large spill/schedule difference (ratio 0.51)

controls.variant: sell_b: swap the base_supply and buyback_fee_basis_points literal fields
controls.result: byte-identical create_sell_event to the base (1e15 constant still 6 slots early)

controls.variant: sell_c: evaluate mayhem conditionals before holder conditionals
sell_v2: capture &context.user etc. as references before Clock::get, deref in literal
controls.result: no gain; the references are re-materialized after the call, constant placement unchanged

controls.variant: sell_v3: destructure TradeEventContext { pool, global_config, base_supply, user, user_base_token_account, user_quote_token_account, .. } before Clock::get
controls.result: gain 0x52c58 (595/118 native), byte-identical builder to the selected let-capture form; not selected only to keep the existing explicit capture style

controls.variant: E1/E2: reorder the context+32/64/96 GEPs or the pool+8 GEP within the same IR block
controls.result: no change: MachineSink always lands the 1e15 PHI-constant materialization at the top of the field-address block

controls.variant: rewrite the two holder-reward selects as one explicit branch diamond
controls.result: 1776 bytes (one diamond instead of two); original has two select diamonds

controls.variant: H1: define the three context+32/64/96 GEPs in the entry block (before the Clock::get call)
controls.result: llc output equals the original window under the retained normalization; this located the source cause (field captures before the fallible Clock call)

controls.variant: llc from platform-tools v1.45, v1.46 (LLVM 18.1.7) and v1.47, v1.48 (LLVM 19.1.7) on the same IR
controls.result: identical to v1.44 output; the residual was IR (source) shaped, not backend-version shaped
no gain; body diverges further (ratio 0.877 vs 0.950 base)

controls.variant: bt_helper: UserVolumeAccumulator::set_user_if_default(&mut self, &Pubkey) method (memcmp + copy_from_slice) called from buy_transfers
move the error block of the last `?` (transfer_checked_to_account_info) after the copy and join blocks (block order only)
controls.result: llc output equals the original window (tokens equal): the residual is IR block order, so the copy block must directly follow the memcmp block at ISel
